notes.title: UI/Lighting Update (Incl. New NPCs)
notes.notes:
Video overview: https://youtu.be/e8GLxp6RYM4

Well its been a long old time but I swore Jank Cube 3000 we will never die so here I am again.
This is sort of mostly a groundwork/in between update so not too much big in here but still a few noteworthy additions.

New lighting in Maps 1, 2, 3, and 11
https://i.imgur.com/LpqcK50.png
Just a taster ^

New UI which is actually UI.
On top of the new UI new player/global settings.
Physics based elevators in Maps 1 and 3.
Fixed gravity staying adjusted when switching scenes.
New custom skyboxes in some levels (just the beginning).
Totally overhauled how the campaign will be introduced (setup for the campaign).
Dummies with health now have toggleable health and make damage sounds when injured.
And of course as always stuff i just straight up forgot.

But all new to this update is something I've worked on for a little while: Attacking Dummies
4 All-new attacker Dummies have been added:
Attacker Dummy: standard attacking dummy.
https://i.imgur.com/LrwCan4.jpeg

And 3 unlockable dummies hidden in levels throughout Jank Cube:
Buff Dummy: bigger and tougher older brother to the Attacker Dummy
Glass Cannon Dummy: standard glass cannon affair, deals tons of damage but goes down easy
God Dummy: pretty much unkillable by all accounts

But the last dummy is actually from the campaign which isn't done yet but I thought could be cool to add.
Nightmare Dummy: a dummy corrupted by a higher power, something's just not right about him...
https://i.imgur.com/UI4fvw6.jpeg

P.S. sorry for the wait becoming an adult is uhh, pretty hard. I said on my discord and I'll repeat it here I'm not fussed if it takes a damn decade to be done with this project I will complete it to the best of my ability. Thank you to anyone who actually has stuck around although I doubt theres many, remember to check out the discord for frequent updates and to report bugs and I guess thats it.

notes.title: PlayBlok Update
notes.notes:
The PlayBlok Update Has Arrived!
After a protracted strenuous struggle with the Unity engine I prevailed, conquerering the beast that challenged me.

Whats new?
PlayBloks (Varying building-block interactbles) and accompanying structures have been scattered around Jank Cube.
Where can you find them I hear you ask, well dear reader let me tell you.
Map 1:
A new area is available for access in the top floor of Map 1, where previously years ago was a race car track now is a sprawling open arena of PlayBloks and PlayBlok structures for you to play with. Walls encase a fortress of towers made all with physics interactables, completely destructible.
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1107787592918904984/1173392031821873251/image.png?ex=6563c97c&is=6551547c&hm=6ad273c495430db99549eca3943b183170612d9571a61ac504bb854ce0a2cfaa&=&width=704&height=700
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1107787592918904984/1173392121038917724/image.png?ex=6563c992&is=65515492&hm=0603e7c3c3ebdf71a48577459ed1f441c5284c84bf0a60ff3a87af7349abbae1&=&width=817&height=700
Map 2: A small complex of smaller towers stand in the top left corner of Map 2, spawnable if you so choose, with a new floor texture to accompany it. All are fully physics and can be torn down if you feel so devious.
https://i.imgur.com/8ERB4B5.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/23bIIou.jpg
Map 3: Repurposing the space where previously was another race track is now a grand open fortress of PlayBloks. Towering skyscrapers stand hundreds of feet in the air, looming above you, accompanied by a number of smaller towers and structures for you to interact with as you see fit.
https://i.imgur.com/1x0IX99.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/lsjCam6.jpg

The PlayBloks are a great way to build structures of your own imagination within Jank Cube. Build a house, build the stonehenge, build nothing, build a staircase to the moon itself, its all up to you. You can even just destroy the existing PlayBlok structures, I'm not gonna stop you.
The PlayBloks also combine perfectly with existing tools! Try dropping a grenade at the base of one of the towers and watching it drop, or slap the walls of one of the fortresses with a table with the GMD, go wild with it.

PlayBloks have also been sprinkled into secret maps!
Map 6: PlayBloks have been added to the empty area beside the escalator area, since that part felt empty, just sprinkled some in for funsies.
Map 8: The complex from map 2 is mirrored in Map 8, as you'd expect.

The PlayBloks definitely expose a need for more player mobility, which will likely be the next update.
It feels like I'm forever saying it but I apologize for the delay but I was experiencing a project corruption which plagued me for weeks and I just yesterday overcame it.

Theres also been some improvements to story elements I meant to do with the previous update but didnt get around to, spoilers ahead if you haven't already experienced the story:
-Andrew's corpse now shows up in Map 1 after completing Map 5
-Andrew's corpse no longer shows up in Map 4 until you've completed Map 5
-Andrew's spawners in the various maps no longer appear until you've completed Map 5
-The Secret Menu section and button of the player menu now appear once you complete Map 5, because I found most people didn't find or press the button to go back to the secret menu and that didn't really make sense anyway.

Glad to be able to get back to work after that bug, and as always a huge thanks goes out to my testers and personal friends who have accompanied me through the journey that progressed over the past 2 weeks, and of course to all my Jankers. I hope you all enjoy this update as much as I did during testing lol.

notes.title: NPC Update
notes.notes:
NPCs have finally hit Jank Cube!
Right now its just a basic assortment of physics dummies, but theres more to come, was trying to get something out since its been a little while since the last update.

Since then I upgraded to Unity 2021, which should generally improve visuals and preformance, win win.
What NPCs are available right now?
Idle Dummy: This dummy is immune to all damage, and simply stands and waits, what for, we don't know.
Follower Dummy: This dummy is also immune to damage, but will follow you around!
Killable Dummy: This dummy is NOT immune to damage, and can die easily, but will still do his best to follow you around, wherever you might go.
Target Dummy: This last dummy is not immune to damage, but alike the idle dummy will just stand around, menacingly, waiting.
The dummies are overall pretty fun to just play around with, they're pretty top heavy and have poor balance so you can easily knock em by grabbing their legs.

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1107787592918904984/1164547778773520385/20231018184445_1.jpg?ex=65439ca2&is=653127a2&hm=f585740b0f0fe449e5d42cb73c674233940953df676a839de8ad21be4d0345f1&=&width=702&height=701

What else is new? General adjustments to an assortment of things, alot of setup for future content.
Also, all ingame sfx are now 3D meaning if you throw an object to the other side of the map you probably wont hear it!
What NPCs can you expect? I'd like to add a couple more dummies, but also maybe some NPC's of existing characters, like the playable character, would be neat.
I'm also still working on more physics tools alike the Gravity Manipulation Device, but focus right now is NPCs.

I know this is a massively requested thing, so I hope you all enjoy!

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1107787592918904984/1164548549585940580/20231018165647_1.jpg?ex=65439d5a&is=6531285a&hm=225fc01eddbcd377d56bf0d5d75776a314f3ddc79ca04fd782378dafa084616b&=&width=702&height=701

notes.title: Universal Render Pipeline Update
notes.notes:
Major changes with this update, gonna be hard to remember all of them but I'll try.
Firstly, render pipeline was switched to Universal RP, which was a major adjustment for me because it broke most of my shaders/materials, and changed massively how lighting worked in every single level, requiring me to start from scracth for a number of them. This has led to alot of changes (I think for the better) for most of them, making them look alot nicer and more unique.
-Tutorial, tutorial has new stuff in it, explains more and has nicer lighting
-Map 1, massive aesthetic changes and new interactables
-Map 3, general aesthetic changes and new interactables
-Map 4, darker, more calm lighting
-Map 6, generally dimmer
-Map 7, generally warmer inside
-Map 9, brighter lighting and aesthetic changes, also new shader for the ocean
-Map 10, not sure how to describe the lighting changes but its definitely different
-Map 11, completely new level, V1 map will return eventually but for now its a totally new level

But this is not all.
A largely requested item has been added to Map 1 and 11, soon to come to the rest.
-Map 1, a shotgun is now available in the spawnables area, with 9 shells that you can clone
-Map 11, 3 unique pistols are available, with a milk bottle shooting range, and the existing shotgun.
I'll bring them to the other levels eventually, I was just really concerned about making them feel right before bringing them in.

A totally new idea, the Gravity Switcher, has been added to every map.
The Gravity Switcher has 3 modes, each of which are labelled and button activated.
On: Gravity on and normal
Moon: Moon gravity, everything is floaty
Off: Gravity is completely off, causes alot of fun mayhem

Certain levels have had unique interactables for a while, and it irritated players because certain items would be perfect in other levels too!
Each level now has:
An mp3 boombox in every level which plays your music in 3D
A Gravity Switcher
A small wireframe bouncy ball
A basketball
Clone/Delete Hammers
Crowbars
Gravity Cups

Another thing, theres now music in the main menu and secret menu, massive shoutout to memepie for making me some banging tunes, you the man dawg. Eventually we hope to have a unique and themed song for every single one of the main 12 maps.

I also made countless bugfixes I can't even recall. Countless adjustments to pacing and sequencing. Countless changes to general interactions and etc, just overally making the game a better experience for everyone!
Thanks to everyone as always, but a special thanks to all my patient players, and my beta testers helping me test everything. This update was a huge undertaking but the game is improved massively in so many areas and just overall we're doing good. I hope you guys enjoy this one as much i have been. [previewyoutube=mOpzw7IcnKw;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
